Audience: every first-time Oregon Class C applicant; speed and lane rules are everyday driving law and heavy knowledge-test material.
Why it matters to a first-timer: the statutory speeds apply even where no sign is posted [A02], pavement markings decide when passing and turning are allowed [A05], and the seconds-based following rule is the core of crash avoidance [A09].
Level: exact-number recall (statutory limits, seconds of following distance) plus visual discrimination of line types; moderate load.
Prerequisites: the signs and traffic signals section, especially speed and advisory signs.
